name: Life
title: The Cradle Beneath the Roots
question: The Widow kept a cradle alive after its child had become the forest. The roots still ask whose life was worth the others.
powerDescription: Sanctuaries restore an additional 24 maximum vitality.

choices.label: Return the cradle
choices.consequence: Bind the forest to a season of birth and winter.
choices.epilogue: The roots loosen their hold on the graves. The child asks for a name, not a crown.

choices.label: Let the forest choose
choices.consequence: Release the borrowed lives into their own keeping.
choices.epilogue: A thousand leaves fall upward. Beyond the road, the first wild sapling grows without a human face.

choices.label: Keep the beating seed
choices.consequence: Carry the life that could have renewed the forest.
choices.epilogue: The cradle empties. Its heartbeat follows your footsteps; the Widow no longer answers the wind.

name: Death
title: The Saint Who Would Not Bury
question: Mara ferried the same funeral for nine centuries. The Saint called this mercy; the dead called it waiting.

choices.label: Give the dead a shore
choices.consequence: Restore a boundary between living and dead.
choices.epilogue: For the first time, the ferry returns empty. Mara sets a place at her table for someone who will never arrive.

choices.label: Burn the passenger lists
choices.consequence: Let every soul decide when to depart.
choices.epilogue: Names rise from the water in different directions. Mara keeps the oar, but throws away the toll box.

choices.label: Command the last crossing
choices.consequence: Become the keeper of every final journey.
choices.epilogue: The ferry kneels in its berth. The dead will need your permission to leave.

name: Time
title: The Hour That Refused to End
question: The Glass Pilgrim walked the desert to postpone an execution. Each horizon was another stolen minute.

choices.label: Start the buried clock
choices.consequence: Allow the abandoned hour to finish.
choices.epilogue: The desert shadows move. Somewhere, a prisoner hears the door open nine centuries too late.

choices.label: Break the clock face
choices.consequence: Release the desert from a single ordained future.
choices.epilogue: Every dune casts two shadows, then one. None point toward the road behind you.

choices.label: Keep the final minute
choices.consequence: Take the hour no one else was permitted to spend.
choices.epilogue: A grain of glass stops beside your hand. Every clock you pass loses a beat.

name: Flame
title: The Furnace of Unsaid Names
question: Veyr burned the records of every person his city sacrificed. The furnace learned to speak them back.

choices.label: Relight the communal hearth
choices.consequence: Make flame answer hunger before ambition.
choices.epilogue: The furnace becomes a thousand small fires. The ash merchant finally opens his winter stores.

choices.label: Give fire its own name
choices.consequence: Let flame exist without an owner.
choices.epilogue: The fire leaves the weapons and settles in the stones. It warms nothing by command again.

choices.label: Wear the furnace heart
choices.consequence: Take the fire that once sustained an empire.
choices.epilogue: Veyr’s final breath lights your shadow. The cold reaches the houses before the smoke clears.

name: Void
title: The Regent Without a Sky
question: The Regent hid a city inside the shadow of a dead sun. Every eclipse kept it safe and erased another street.

choices.label: Open the eclipse gates
choices.consequence: Restore the boundary that keeps absence outside.
choices.epilogue: Morning finds a city with no roofs. The surviving streets remember the people they sheltered.

choices.label: Let the shadow go
choices.consequence: Allow the hidden city to return on its own terms.
choices.epilogue: Doors open onto unfamiliar hills. The Regent’s people leave without asking which kingdom owns them.

choices.label: Keep the city between worlds
choices.consequence: Rule a refuge no daylight can reach.
choices.epilogue: One last window closes. Its light remains beneath your skin.

name: Memory
title: The Unwritten Witness
question: Your First Shadow carries the account removed from every archive. It remembers a consent the prophecy never sought.

choices.label: Return the missing pages
choices.consequence: Let the archive preserve every contradictory account.
choices.epilogue: The shelves fill with witnesses who disagree. The Unwritten smiles at the first honest history.

choices.label: Give the memories back
choices.consequence: Let their owners decide what deserves remembering.
choices.epilogue: Books open into voices. Some thank you; some ask why you waited.

choices.label: Become the only witness
choices.consequence: Carry the account no one else may read.
choices.epilogue: The archive goes quiet. Every unwritten sentence now begins with your name.

name: Creation
title: The Empty Chair
question: The Last Witness wrote a prophecy to make a willing jailer. Creation was not destroyed: its right to refuse was.
powerDescription: Maximum focus and stamina each increase by 10.

choices.label: Rebuild the chair with an empty seat
choices.consequence: Make creation a duty no ruler can inherit.
choices.epilogue: Seven seats circle an eighth space. The Witness cannot predict what will fill it.

choices.label: Leave the first question unanswered
choices.consequence: Refuse to turn possibility into another law.
choices.epilogue: The fracture remains, but light passes through it. For the first time, nothing asks to be completed.

choices.label: Write the next beginning
choices.consequence: Accept authorship and its unpayable debt.
choices.epilogue: The first word waits. Somewhere beyond the page, someone has already begun to disagree.
